messages.author: aa122bb46709d464
messages.subject: Re: equenza.extract error
parts:
Hi all, 
I also encountered a similar problem when using it. I found through inspection that this problem may be related to the version of readr. By replacing read_tsv(file = paste(mstrsplit(x), collapse = "\n") in the three functions of read.seqz.chr() read.seqz.tbi() gc.sample.stats() with read_tsv(file = I(paste(mstrsplit(res), collapse = "\n"))) solved this error.
Hope it can help those in need
